entries: Energy comes in many forms: light rays spread out in straight lines, heat rises up, sound spreads out from where it is made, movement slides along, and stored energy waits quietly in its box.
slots.label: Many forms of energy
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: We use energy every day: a lamp sends out light, cooking heat rises from the pot, a radio sends out sound, and a car changes stored energy in its fuel into movement.
slots.label: We use energy every day
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Energy changes form: electrical energy waits stored in the battery, travels along the wire to the bulb, and changes into light and heat at the bulb.
slots.label: Energy changes form
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: A common mistake: is energy used up? No - the energy travels from the stored circle to the heat circle along the chain, changing form and moving somewhere else instead of disappearing.
slots.label: Is energy used up?
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: The form of energy that races out from a lamp or the Sun in straight lines and lets us see.
slots.label: Light
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: Warm energy that moves from hot things to cooler places: it rises up from a cooking pot into the air.
slots.label: Heat
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The form of energy made when something vibrates: it spreads out in all directions from where it is made, like sound from a radio.
slots.label: Sound
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The energy of something moving: a rolling car and a sliding ball carry movement energy.
slots.label: Movement
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: Energy kept waiting until it is needed: it sits stored in a battery or in fuel, ready to change into other forms.
slots.label: Stored energy
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: Energy carried by electricity as it travels along wires: a battery supplies it and a bulb changes it into light and heat.
slots.label: Electrical energy
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.
